I'm Jomari Iro Lladones, a graphic designer from Cavite, Philippines. My practice grew out of real organizational needs — student government required visibility, businesses needed brand assets, events needed materials. I showed up with tools and learned fast.

I use Adobe Creative Suite and DaVinci Resolve for design and motion, comfortable across the full content pipeline — from concept to scheduling to publishing on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.

Currently looking for an entry-level Social Media VA role where I can contribute visual quality and genuine drive.

01 — Electoral Campaign

PARTIDO MAGDALO

Two distinct visual identities for the same student party across two election cycles — different year, different color language.

Partido Magdalo — 2024
Wave-themed in deep navy and sky blue. Clean and trustworthy. The "Voyage" wordmark anchored a campaign built on progress.
Tindig Magdalo — 2025
Fire and crimson for a new cycle. "Tindig" means stand up. Bolder, more urgent. Gold accents reinforced a call to rise.
